title: Resident Evil Requiem
summary: Resident Evil Requiem launched on Switch 2 on February 27, 2026, at 28.7 GB, a mid-sized install that leaves plenty of room on the 256 GB console. The physical release is a Game-Key Card, so you will need to download those 28.7 GB even if you buy the box. CAPCOM targets 60 FPS in both modes, but independent testing shows it often runs in the 40s and 50s, dropping to about 30 FPS docked and 25 FPS handheld in heavy scenes. Image quality is the trade-off: it renders at about 540p on the TV, upscaled with DLSS, and about 360p in handheld mode. It is fully playable, but if you also own a PS5 or a gaming PC, those versions look and run noticeably better.
